title: NetworkAccountDeletion
description: network.account-deletion@1 (OpenVibe.Network; roadmap WS-B task 7, ADR-033): a person's scheduled account deletion. POST /api/v1/account/deletion (a fresh sign-in, auth_time within 10 minutes, and the username typed out) schedules it 30 days ahead; GET answers it; DELETE cancels it before delete_after.

delete_after.description: Nothing leaves Network before this time; the account works normally until then.
